'''Owal Sopil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who served [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], one of the most feared criminal organizations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Unaware of exactly who he was working for, Sopil tried to skim some cargo during his runs; when Black Sun found out he was taken to a remote bunker complex on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to await a decision on his fate by the local [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]]. News of Sopil's capture soon reached his brother, [[Reik Sopil|Reik]], who recruited [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] to assist in a rescue. The rescuers arrived on Endor shortly after the local Vigo and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] assistant, the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]], traveled to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to deal with Sopil and other matters.
